credits.title: Naina
credits.overview: Naina Ocean in the Desert is a powerful social drama about a brave village girl who challenges tradition, promotes women’s education and healthcare, and sacrifices her life fighting for dignity and change.

credits.title: Maatrubhumi:  May War Rest in Peace
credits.overview: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

credits.title: Wanton
credits.overview: On a fateful night, the lives of three friends descend into chaos after one of them commits a gruesome crime in a nightclub.
